meta.title: CS2 Sensitivity Converter - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Convert any game's sensitivity to CS2. Enter your DPI and source sensitivity for an instant match.
sensConverterDesc: Enter your sensitivity and DPI — conversion updates automatically.
cm360Desc: Distance your mouse must travel for one full 360° rotation
steps_cs2-sensitivity-converter_1Desc: Type your CS2 sensitivity from Settings → Keyboard/Mouse → Mouse Sensitivity. This is your base value for cross-game conversion.
steps_cs2-sensitivity-converter_2Desc: Choose the destination game. The converter matches your CS2 360° rotation distance to the equivalent setting in the target game.
steps_cs2-sensitivity-converter_3Desc: Copy the result, apply in-game, then fine-tune ±10% based on feel. Different game engines and FoVs affect perceived sensitivity even when mathematically matched.
desc: Convert any game's sensitivity to CS2. Enter your DPI and source sensitivity for an instant match.
